items.quote: In the field of behavioural decision-making, “loss aversion” is a behavioural phenomenon in which individuals show a higher sensitivity to potential losses than to gains.
items.statement: Loss aversion is a behavioral phenomenon in which individuals show a higher sensitivity to potential losses than to gains.

items.quote: In the context of finance, FOMO arises when people feel the pressure to invest in an asset or a stock because they fear missing out on potential gains.
items.statement: FOMO arises when people feel pressure to invest due to fear of missing out on potential gains.

items.quote: you can communicate this by sharing success stories of other investors who have navigated market fluctuations and experienced positive returns on their real estate investments.
items.statement: Use success stories to communicate loss aversion and build investor confidence.

items.quote: If you just communicate it directly, you will come across as pushy and salesy - which immediately triggers the client's sales resistance and vanishes the trust you’ve been building from the beginning.
items.statement: Direct communication without a strategy can trigger client resistance.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing sales strategies using psychological concepts.
